resources.string: Maintains USB and Wi-Fi streaming while the device is locked.
Drone Bridge requires notification permission to display streaming status and maintain background streaming while the device is locked in your pocket.
To prevent the device from suspending USB and Wi-Fi streaming when the screen is locked in your pocket, allow Drone Bridge to run unrestricted in the background.
